home.heroTitle: Apartments in the heart of Los Pedroches
home.heroSubtitle: Five refurbished apartments in the centre of Pozoblanco, made for a getaway into the dehesa and for work stays alike.

values.title: In the centre of Pozoblanco
values.text: Steps from shops, bars, the local hospital and the industrial estates. No need to take the car for everything.

values.title: A separate kitchen
values.text: Properly equipped, not a corner with a microwave. Made for stays of several days.

values.title: Book direct, no commission
values.text: The same apartment, a better price than on the platforms. What you save doesn't go to a middleman.

values.title: Direct contact with the owner
values.text: No call centres or automated replies. You write, and whoever holds the keys answers.

home.apartmentsSubtitle: Five one-bedroom apartments with a separate kitchen, all in the centre.
home.directTitle: Book direct: same apartment, better price
home.directText: When you book through Booking or Airbnb, part of what you pay stays with the platform. Booking here, that margin stays between you and us.
directPoints: Better price than on the platforms
Flexibility to arrange check-in and check-out times
Direct contact by phone or WhatsApp
home.zoneTitle: Los Pedroches is closer than you think
home.zoneText: Holm oak dehesa as far as the eye can see, granite villages, castles and Córdoba's finest acorn-fed Iberian ham. Pozoblanco is the gateway to the valley.
home.finalCtaText: Tell us your dates and we'll confirm availability and price.

zone.title: The area
zone.intro: Pozoblanco is the capital of Los Pedroches, a dehesa valley in the north of the province of Córdoba. Here's what you can do if you're staying a few days.

zone.getThereIntro: Pozoblanco is well connected by road to Córdoba, Madrid and Extremadura.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: What people most often ask before booking.

items.q: What time can I check in and out?
items.a: Check-in is from 4pm and check-out before 11am. If you book directly with us, we can adjust the times depending on occupancy.

items.q: Do I have to pay a deposit?
items.a: Still to be confirmed. We'll state it here before opening direct bookings.
Yes, all apartments include wifi in the price.

items.q: Can I book for a single night?
items.a: The minimum stay per season is still to be confirmed.

items.q: What happens if I need to cancel?
items.a: The cancellation policy for direct bookings is still to be defined. On Booking and Airbnb, the one stated in each listing applies.

faq.pendingNote: Some answers are still to be confirmed. They'll be completed before the website goes live.
